services.name: Bowen Island Sea Kayaking
services.desc: Bowen Island Sea Kayaking is dedicated to offering safe, informative, and fun experiences on the water to both novice and experienced paddlers. We provide well maintained kayaks, paddling gear, and safety equipment. We also offer every guest a basic paddling orientation. Bowen Island Sea Kayaking is committed to protecting the marine environment, and we share this attitude, as well as our knowledge of the local ecology with guests.
